mpa-vandenberg.note: Read the official CDFW Vandenberg SMR page and coordinates. It prohibits take and describes restricted public entry. Its 32.91 square miles are a reserve, not fishable reef habitat.

mpa-point-conception.note: Read the official CDFW Point Conception SMR page and coordinates. It prohibits take in the mapped reserve; the regional 34°27 N management line does not erase this exclusion.

access-vandenberg-maritime.note: Held: this official Vandenberg maritime-update URL returned HTTP 403 from the scheduled collector. The public official page says Danger Zone 4 is always closed and launch zones change, but there is no fresh adapter receipt or live clearance.

mpa-ano-greyhound.note: Inspected CDFW Año Nuevo SMR and Greyhound Rock SMCA page: Año Nuevo reserve prohibits take; Greyhound Rock has specified hook-and-line shoreline finfish, giant kelp, salmon and market squid exceptions. SkipperCast excludes both mapped areas from all fishing targets and exports.

mpa-soquel-canyon.note: Inspected CDFW Soquel Canyon SMCA page and coordinates: pelagic finfish take is excepted, while other marine take is prohibited. The app conservatively excludes the mapped area from every target and export.

mpa-portuguese-ledge.note: Inspected CDFW Portuguese Ledge SMCA page and coordinates: pelagic finfish take is permitted and non-pelagic take is prohibited. The app conservatively excludes the mapped area from every target and export.

mpa-carmel-pinnacles.note: Read CDFW Carmel Pinnacles SMR page and coordinates: no take is allowed. Granite spires are within the reserve and are not a fishing target.

mpa-carmel-bay.note: Read CDFW Carmel Bay SMCA page and coordinates: recreational finfish take may be allowed, subject to other limits. Exclude the polygon from all app targets conservatively.

mpa-point-lobos.note: Read CDFW Point Lobos SMR and SMCA page: reserve prohibits take and conservation area has stated exceptions. Exclude both mapped polygons from targets.

mpa-point-sur.note: Read CDFW Point Sur SMR and SMCA page: reserve prohibits take; conservation area allows salmon and albacore only. Exclude both polygons.

mpa-ricketts-lovers.note: Read CDFW Ricketts and Lovers Point page: reserve prohibits take; Ricketts SMCA has restricted hook-and-line finfish exception. Exclude both mapped polygons.

mpa-asilomar.note: Read CDFW Asilomar and Pacific Grove page: Asilomar reserve prohibits take; Pacific Grove SMCA permits finfish with other limits. Exclude all mapped polygon portions.
